children: Control Empresarial De Capitales S.A. De C.V., a 10% Owner, reported sales of Talos Energy common shares on 2026-10-13 and 2026-10-14. The transactions were sales with weighted average prices of $17.5101 for the 2,700,000-share lot and $17.3017 for the 265,446-share lot. The total sale amount reported was $51,869,937. Following the reported transactions, the reporter directly owns 29,393,590 common shares.
